title: AlertEvent
description: Standardized alert event schema emitted to topic alerts per NOTE.md §6.2

alert_id.description: Unique identifier for this alert event

severity_level.description: Numeric severity ranking matching Postgres alert.severity (1=CRITICAL, 2=HIGH, 3=WARN, 4=INFO)

event_ts.description: Timestamp of the triggering canonical telemetry event

emit_ts.description: Timestamp when alert was evaluated and produced by alerts engine

latency_ms.description: Latency in milliseconds between event_ts and emit_ts (Target: p99 < 5000ms)

lat.description: Vehicle latitude at the time of the event

lon.description: Vehicle longitude at the time of the event

detail.description: Diagnostic and contextual telemetry parameters specific to the alert rule
